nodes.name: transfer-panel-layout/spec.md
nodes.summary: OpenSpec specification for the responsive Transfer panel layout, defining container-width adaptation, touch target sizing, mascot retention, a stable two-zone structure, and mobile card chrome dissolution across 7 requirements with Given/When/Then scenarios.

nodes.name: transport-dest/spec.md
nodes.summary: OpenSpec specification for the receive-destination module, requiring dated per-transfer folders, path-escape-safe filename sanitizing, and colocated tests, keeping destination logic out of the transport manager.

nodes.name: transport-iroh/spec.md
nodes.summary: OpenSpec specification for the iroh-based P2P transfer transport, covering direct/relay transfer, ticket addressing, race-free progress reporting, content-addressed resume, cancellation, concurrency limits, and configurable relay.

nodes.name: prettier.config.js
nodes.summary: Prettier formatting configuration for the project, wiring in the Svelte and Tailwind plugins and code-style options.

nodes.name: doctor-macos.sh
nodes.summary: macOS dev-environment doctor script invoked by `mise run doctor` that verifies and self-heals the toolchain for iOS, Android, and desktop Tauri builds (xcode-select, rustup default, mobile Rust targets, Android SDK/NDK/AVD, and Gradle/Vite port traps).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `set -uo pipefail` and captures rustc output before grep to avoid SIGPIPE under pipefail.

nodes.name: doctor-windows.ps1
nodes.summary: Windows dev-environment doctor script that verifies the desktop-only Tauri build toolchain, self-healing a broken bare rustc via rustup default and warning when the MSVC link.exe linker is missing.

nodes.name: build.rs
nodes.summary: Cargo build script for the Tauri crate that delegates to tauri_build::build() to generate platform bindings and embed app metadata at compile time.

nodes.name: android.json
nodes.summary: Android-only Tauri capability granting the android-fs permission so received transfers can be written to the public Downloads collection without needing storage permission on API 29+.

nodes.name: default.json
nodes.summary: Default Tauri capability for the main window, allowing window controls plus opener, dialog, clipboard, notification, deep-link, and filesystem plugin permissions.

nodes.name: app/build.gradle.kts
nodes.summary: Gradle build script for the Android app module, configuring SDK levels, the com.nimayer.floppy application id, debug/release build types with ProGuard and cleartext toggles, the rust plugin, and AndroidX dependencies.
nodes.languageNotes: Reads versionCode/versionName from tauri.properties and glob-collects *.pro ProGuard files for the release build type.

nodes.name: proguard-floppy.pro
nodes.summary: App-specific ProGuard/R8 keep rules for the floppy release build, preserving classes that reflection or JNI would otherwise strip.

nodes.name: proguard-rules.pro
nodes.summary: Default ProGuard/R8 configuration for the Android app module, holding project-wide code-shrinking and obfuscation keep rules for release builds.

nodes.name: AndroidManifest.xml
nodes.summary: Android app manifest declaring the INTERNET permission, the singleTask MainActivity with launcher and floppy:// deep-link intent filters, AndroidTV leanback support, and a FileProvider for sharing received files.

nodes.name: MainActivity.kt
nodes.summary: Android entry Activity extending Tauri's Wry activity, enabling edge-to-edge rendering and bridging system-bar, cutout, and IME insets into the WebView as safe-area CSS variables via a JavaScript interface.

nodes.name: ic_launcher_foreground.xml
nodes.summary: Vector drawable defining the adaptive launcher icon foreground layer for API 24+ Android devices.

nodes.name: ic_launcher_background.xml
nodes.summary: Vector drawable defining the adaptive launcher icon background layer, composed of many path elements forming the icon backdrop.

nodes.name: activity_main.xml
nodes.summary: Android layout resource for the main activity, hosting the Tauri WebView container.

nodes.name: ic_launcher.xml
nodes.summary: Adaptive icon resource for API 26+ that composes the launcher foreground and background drawable layers.

nodes.name: themes.xml
nodes.summary: Night-mode (dark theme) resource defining the Theme.floppy style overrides applied when the device is in dark mode.

nodes.name: file_paths.xml
nodes.summary: FileProvider path configuration declaring which directories the app may expose as content URIs for sharing received files.

nodes.name: build.gradle.kts
nodes.summary: Root Gradle build script for the Android project, declaring the Android Gradle Plugin and Kotlin plugin classpath and shared repositories for all modules.

nodes.name: buildSrc/build.gradle.kts
nodes.summary: Gradle build script for the buildSrc module that compiles the custom Kotlin `rust` plugin, pulling in the Android Gradle Plugin and Kotlin Gradle plugin as dependencies.

nodes.name: BuildTask.kt
nodes.summary: Custom Gradle task that builds the Rust dynamic library for a given Android target by shelling out to the Tauri CLI (npm/cargo/pnpm), threading through the target triple and release flag.

nodes.name: RustPlugin.kt
nodes.summary: Custom Gradle plugin that wires Rust cross-compilation into the Android build, creating per-ABI product flavors and registering BuildTask instances per architecture that the JNI-lib merge tasks depend on.

nodes.name: gradle.properties
nodes.summary: Project-wide Gradle properties setting daemon JVM args, enabling AndroidX, official Kotlin code style, and non-transitive R classes for the Android build.

nodes.name: MainActivity
nodes.summary: Tauri WebView host Activity that enables edge-to-edge display and forwards system window insets into the WebView as safe-area values.

nodes.name: onWebViewCreate
nodes.summary: Installs a JavaScript SafeAreaBridge and a window-insets listener that computes system-bar, cutout, and IME insets and pushes them into the WebView as CSS safe-area variables.

nodes.name: BuildTask
nodes.summary: Gradle DefaultTask that invokes the Tauri CLI to build the Rust library for one Android target triple in debug or release mode.

nodes.name: assemble
nodes.summary: Task action that resolves the platform-appropriate Tauri CLI executable and runs the Android build for the configured target.

nodes.name: runTauriCli
nodes.summary: Executes the Tauri CLI android-build command in the project root with the target and release arguments, asserting a normal exit and raising a GradleException on invalid configuration.

nodes.name: RustPlugin
nodes.summary: Gradle Plugin that integrates Rust cross-compilation into the Android build by declaring per-ABI product flavors and registering per-architecture BuildTasks.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: Plugin entry point that reads ABI/arch/target properties, creates the universal and per-arch product flavors, and after evaluation registers rustBuild tasks wired into the JNI-lib merge tasks.
